summary: This medicine can increase the risk of infections, so a complete blood count test should be done before starting it, and patients should be watched for infections while taking it and for two months after stopping [3]. Treatment should not be started in people who currently have active infections [3]. A small computer model, rather than tests on real people, gave this medicine a low liver score of 20 and a high heart score of 65 [M].
